lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary arrangement of high-luminance circular spots follows a rectilinear grid along the lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating distinct grid-like nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a highlight on the dorsal side and a shadow on the ventral side of the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, high-luminance spots are distributed across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with a higher density observed towards the base and anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The head region anterior to the gill slits displays a dense population of micro-spots, contrasting with the larger, more spaced spots on the main body flank.
